cases.input:
name: Azure Login Bypassing Conditional Access Policies
id: 13f2d3f5-6497-44a7-bf5f-dc13ffafe5dc
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2025-01-08"
author: Josh Nickels, Marius Rothenbücher
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 13f2d3f5-6497-44a7-bf5f-dc13ffafe5dc
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: match
description: >
  Detects a successful login to the Microsoft Intune Company Portal which could
  allow bypassing Conditional Access Policies and InTune device trust using a
  tool like TokenSmith. MITRE ATT&CK: T1078.
data_source:
  - Office 365 Management Activity API
  - "Workload: AzureActiveDirectory"
workload: AzureActiveDirectory
how_to_implement: >
  Requires the Wazuh office365 module configured with an Azure AD application

cases.label: rule file detections/Exchange/m365_email_forwarding_created.yaml
cases.input:
name: M365 Email Forwarding Created
id: M365_Email_Forwarding_Created
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-07-02"
author: SOCFortress LLC
status: production
type: match
description: >
  Detects mailbox-level email forwarding being configured via Set-Mailbox, where
  either a forwarding SMTP address or a forwarding recipient is set to a non-empty
  value. Attackers configure mailbox forwarding after compromising an account to
  silently exfiltrate a copy of all incoming mail to an address they control,
  supporting business email compromise and long-term collection. Both
  ForwardingSmtpAddress (a raw external SMTP target) and ForwardingAddress (a
  directory recipient, which can point to an attacker-created mail contact) are
  covered, since either can be abused for exfiltration. Events that clear or
  disable forwarding (empty value) are excluded.
  MITRE ATT&CK: T1114.003 (Email Collection: Email Forwarding Rule).
data_source:
  - Office 365 Management Activity API
  - "Workload: Exchange"
workload: Exchange
how_to_implement: >
  Requires the Office 365 audit log ingestion pipeline feeding Graylog via the
  O365 Management Activity API, with Exchange admin auditing enabled so
  Set-Mailbox operations (RecordType 1, ExchangeAdmin) are recorded. This is a
  single-event match detection. Set-Mailbox is a high-volume administrative
  operation used for many settings, so the query filters on the forwarding
  parameters specifically: ForwardingSmtpAddress and ForwardingAddress, carried
  in data_office365_Parameters as a flattened string of {Name=..., Value=...}
  pairs. The Value=[^}] guard requires a non-empty value so that events which
  clear or disable forwarding (empty value) do not fire. These parameter names
  are standard Exchange Online fields and are consistent across tenants and
  locales. Note: data_office365_ClientIP includes an appended source port for
  these admin-log events.
known_false_positives: >
  Administrators and users may configure forwarding legitimately (delegation,
  shared-mailbox routing, temporary out-of-office forwarding to a colleague).
  Forwarding to an external, non-corporate domain is the higher-risk case and
  should be prioritized on review. The rule surfaces the full forwarding target
  in the alert so the analyst can quickly judge internal vs external.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1114/003/
response:
  message: >
    Mailbox forwarding configured by $data_office365_UserId$ from
    $data_office365_ClientIP$ on mailbox $data_office365_ObjectId$.
    Forwarding details: $data_office365_Parameters$.
    Review the forwarding target for external/attacker-controlled addresses.
    MITRE ATT&CK: T1114.003
  risk_score: 70
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: data_office365_UserId
      type: user
      score: 70
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_office365_ClientIP
      type: ip_address
    - field: data_office365_ObjectId
      type: mailbox
tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Office 365 Persistence
    - Business Email Compromise
  asset_type: Cloud Identity
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1114.003
  custom_tags:
    - o365
    - exchange
    - mail_forwarding
    - set_mailbox
    - persistence
    - bec
  product:
    - Office 365
  security_domain: cloud
graylog:
  query: data_office365_Operation:"Set-Mailbox" AND (data_office365_Parameters:/.*ForwardingSmtpAddress, Value=[^}].*/ OR data_office365_Parameters:/.*ForwardingAddress, Value=[^}].*/)

  Detects a single user deleting an unusually high volume of email messages
  within a short time window, excluding routine cleanup of the Deleted Items
  and Junk folders. Bulk deletion from the Inbox, Sent Items, or Drafts is a
  common anti-forensics and evidence-destruction technique following a business
  email compromise or account takeover, where an attacker removes traces of
  phishing replies, fraudulent messages, or forwarded mail. Covers both
  SoftDelete (moved to recoverable items) and HardDelete (permanent purge).
  MITRE ATT&CK: T1070.008 (Indicator Removal: Clear Mailbox Data), T1114 (Email Collection).
data_source:
  - Office 365 Management Activity API
  - "Workload: Exchange"
workload: Exchange
how_to_implement: >
  Requires the Office 365 audit log ingestion pipeline feeding Graylog via the
  O365 Management Activity API, with Exchange mailbox auditing enabled so
  SoftDelete and HardDelete operations (RecordType 3, ExchangeItemGroup) are
  recorded. This is an aggregation detection: the base graylog.query isolates
  delete events and excludes deletions originating from Deleted Items and Junk
  folders, and the aggregation block counts them per user over the window.
  Note: data_office365_Folder_Path is localized per tenant language (e.g.
  "Deleted Items", "Itens Excluidos", "Elementos eliminados", "Correo no deseado",
  "Junk Email", "Lixo Eletronico"); the exclusion regex covers English, Portuguese,
  and Spanish variants and may need additional folder names added for tenants in
  other locales. Each delete event carries a single message in
  data_office365_AffectedItems, so event count is a close proxy for messages
  deleted. O365 CreationTime arrives with a malformed timezone offset (+0000) and
  is replaced at ingest, so windowing keys off Graylog's own timestamp rather than
  data_office365_CreationTime. Confirmed against live AGTNetworks tenant data.
known_false_positives: >
  Users performing legitimate bulk cleanup of their Inbox (mass-selecting and
  deleting old mail, newsletter purges, mailbox archiving) can trigger this.
  Automated mailbox rules and retention/cleanup tooling may also delete in bulk.
  Emptying the Deleted Items or Junk folder is already excluded. Tune the
  threshold per tenant and consider excluding known automation/service accounts.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1070/008/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1114/
response:
  message: >
    Mass email deletion detected: $data_office365_UserId$ deleted a high volume
    of messages (excluding Deleted Items/Junk cleanup) within the aggregation
    window. Source IP: $data_office365_ClientIP$ ($data_office365_ClientIP_country_code$).
    Possible evidence wipe following account compromise. MITRE ATT&CK: T1070.008
  risk_score: 70
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: data_office365_UserId
      type: user
      score: 70
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_office365_ClientIP
      type: ip_address
    - field: data_office365_Folder_Path
      type: folder
tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Office 365 Anti-Forensics
    - Business Email Compromise
  asset_type: Cloud Identity
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1070.008
    - T1114
  custom_tags:
    - o365
    - exchange
    - mail_deletion
    - anti_forensics
    - evidence_wipe
    - aggregation
  product:
    - Office 365
  security_domain: cloud
graylog:
  query: data_office365_Operation:("SoftDelete" OR "HardDelete") AND NOT data_office365_Folder_Path:/.*([dD]eleted [iI]tems|[jJ]unk [eE]mail|[iI]tens [eE]xclu.dos|[eE]lementos eliminados|[cC]orreo no deseado|[lL]ixo [eE]letr.nico).*/
aggregation:
  enabled: true
  function: count
  field: null
  group_by:
    - data_office365_UserId
  window: 10m
  threshold: 30
  condition: ">"

cases.input:
name: Atera Agent Installation
id: 87261fb2-69d0-42fe-b9de-88c6b5f65a43
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2022-12-25"
author: Bhabesh Raj
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 87261fb2-69d0-42fe-b9de-88c6b5f65a43
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects successful installation of Atera Remote Monitoring & Management (RMM)
  agent as recently found to be used by Conti operators. MITRE ATT&CK:
  T1219.002.

data_source:
  - Windows Application Event Log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "1033"
        - term:
            data_win_system_providerName:
              value: "MsiInstaller"
              case_insensitive: true
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_message:
              value: "*AteraAgent*"
              case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_system_providerName
    - data_win_eventdata_message

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires the relevant built-in Windows event channel collected by the Wazuh
  agent (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf). The detection looks for
  events where data_win_system_eventID equals '1033';
  data_win_system_providerName equals 'MsiInstaller'; data_win_eventdata_message
  matches '*AteraAgent*'.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate Atera agent installation. Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - https://www.advintel.io/post/secret-backdoor-behind-conti-ransomware-operation-introducing-atera-agent
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1219/002/

response:
  message: >
    Atera Agent Installation detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_system_providerName: $data_win_system_providerName$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_message: $data_win_eventdata_message$. MITRE ATT&CK:
    T1219.002
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_system_providerName
      type: other
    - field: data_win_eventdata_message
      type: other

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1219.002
  custom_tags:
    - atera
    - agent
    - installation
    - windows_application
    - command_and_control
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"1033" AND data_win_system_providerName:/[Mm][Ss][Ii][Ii][Nn][Ss][Tt][Aa][Ll][Ll][Ee][Rr]/ AND data_win_eventdata_message:/.*[Aa][Tt][Ee][Rr][Aa][Aa][Gg][Ee][Nn][Tt].*/

  syscalls/paths, and the Wazuh agent reading /var/log/audit/audit.log (default
  localfile entry). The detection looks for events where data_audit_type equals
  'PATH'; data_audit_file_name matches '/etc/audit/*'; data_audit_file_name
  equals '/etc/libaudit.conf', among other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate administrative activity. Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - https://github.com/Neo23x0/auditd/blob/master/audit.rules
  - Self Experience

  risk_score: 75

cases.input:
name: LSASS Access Detected via Attack Surface Reduction
id: a0a278fe-2c0e-4de2-ac3c-c68b08a9ba98
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2022-08-13"
author: Markus Neis
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: a0a278fe-2c0e-4de2-ac3c-c68b08a9ba98
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects Access to LSASS Process. MITRE ATT&CK: T1003.001.

data_source:
  - Windows Defender Operational Event Log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "1121"
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_path:
              value: "*\\\\lsass.exe"
              case_insensitive: true
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_processName"
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - bool:
                  should:
                    - bool:
                        must:
                          - wildcard:
                              data_win_eventdata_processName:
                                value: "C:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\asgard2-agent\\\\*"
                                case_insensitive: true
                          - bool:
                              should:
                                - wildcard:
                                    data_win_eventdata_processName:
                                      value: "*\\\\thor64.exe"
                                      case_insensitive: true
                                - wildcard:
                                    data_win_eventdata_processName:
                                      value: "*\\\\thor.exe"
                                      case_insensitive: true
                              minimum_should_match: 1
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\atiesrxx.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\CompatTelRunner.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\nvwmi64.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\Taskmgr.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\DriverStore\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Installer\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\\\Program Files\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_processName:
                          value: "C:\\\\Program Files (x86)\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                  minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_path
    - data_win_eventdata_processName

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires the relevant built-in Windows event channel collected by the Wazuh
  agent (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf). The detection looks for
  events where data_win_system_eventID equals '1121'; data_win_eventdata_path
  matches '*\lsass.exe'; data_win_eventdata_processName matches
  'C:\Windows\Temp\asgard2-agent\*', among other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Google Chrome GoogleUpdate.exe. Some Taskmgr.exe related activity. Baseline
  expected activity in your environment and tune this detection before relying
  on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/attack-surface-reduction
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/

response:
  message: >
    LSASS Access Detected via Attack Surface Reduction detected on host
    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_eventdata_path: $data_win_eventdata_path$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_processName: $data_win_eventdata_processName$.
    MITRE ATT&CK: T1003.001
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_path
      type: file_name
    - field: data_win_eventdata_processName
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1003.001
  custom_tags:
    - lsass
    - attack
    - surface
    - defender
    - credential_access
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"1121" AND data_win_eventdata_path:/.*\\[Ll][Ss][Aa][Ss][Ss]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ AND _exists_:data_win_eventdata_processName AND NOT ((data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Tt][Ee][Mm][Pp]\\[Aa][Ss][Gg][Aa][Rr][Dd]2-[Aa][Gg][Ee][Nn][Tt]\\.*/ AND (data_win_eventdata_processName:/.*\\[Tt][Hh][Oo][Rr]64\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/.*\\[Tt][Hh][Oo][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/)) OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Aa][Tt][Ii][Ee][Ss][Rr][Xx][Xx]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Cc][Oo][Mm][Pp][Aa][Tt][Tt][Ee][Ll][Rr][Uu][Nn][Nn][Ee][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Mm][Ss][Ii][Ee][Xx][Ee][Cc]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Nn][Vv][Ww][Mm][Ii]64\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Ss][Vv][Cc][Hh][Oo][Ss][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Tt][Aa][Ss][Kk][Mm][Gg][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Ww][Bb][Ee][Mm]\\[Ww][Mm][Ii][Pp][Rr][Vv][Ss][Ee]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Ww][Oo][Ww]64\\[Mm][Ss][Ii][Ee][Xx][Ee][Cc]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Dd][Rr][Ii][Vv][Ee][Rr][Ss][Tt][Oo][Rr][Ee]\\.*/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ii][Nn][Ss][Tt][Aa][Ll][Ll][Ee][Rr]\\.*/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Pp][Rr][Oo][Gg][Rr][Aa][Mm] [Ff][Ii][Ll][Ee][Ss]\\.*/ OR data_win_eventdata_processName:/[Cc]:\\[Pp][Rr][Oo][Gg][Rr][Aa][Mm] [Ff][Ii][Ll][Ee][Ss] \([Xx]86\)\\.*/)

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_01_process_creation/7zip_compressing_dump_files.yaml
cases.input:
name: 7Zip Compressing Dump Files
id: ec570e53-4c76-45a9-804d-dc3f355ff7a7
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-06-05"
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: ec570e53-4c76-45a9-804d-dc3f355ff7a7
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects execution of 7z in order to compress a file with a ".dmp"/".dump"
  extension, which could be a step in a process of dump file exfiltration. MITRE
  ATT&CK: T1560.001.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 1 - Process Creation

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "1"
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_description:
                    value: "*7-Zip*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_image:
                    value: "*\\\\7z.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_image:
                    value: "*\\\\7zr.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_image:
                    value: "*\\\\7za.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - term:
                  data_win_eventdata_originalFileName:
                    value: "7z.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - term:
                  data_win_eventdata_originalFileName:
                    value: "7za.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - term:
                  data_win_eventdata_originalFileName:
                    value: "7zr.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_commandLine:
                    value: "*.dmp*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_commandLine:
                    value: "*.dump*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_commandLine:
                    value: "*.hdmp*"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_description
    - data_win_eventdata_image
    - data_win_eventdata_originalFileName
    - data_win_eventdata_commandLine
    - data_win_eventdata_parentImage
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 1 (process creation) collected from the
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel by the Wazuh agent (eventchannel
  localfile entry in ossec.conf) and ingested into the wazuh-* indices. The
  detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_description matches
  '*7-Zip*'; data_win_eventdata_image matches '*\7z.exe';
  data_win_eventdata_image matches '*\7zr.exe', among other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate use of 7z with a command line in which ".dmp" or ".dump" appears
  accidentally. Legitimate use of 7z to compress WER ".dmp" files for
  troubleshooting. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://thedfirreport.com/2022/09/26/bumblebee-round-two/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1560/001/

response:
  message: >
    7Zip Compressing Dump Files detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_description: $data_win_eventdata_description$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_image: $data_win_eventdata_image$. MITRE ATT&CK:
    T1560.001
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_description
      type: other
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1560.001
  custom_tags:
    - compressing
    - process_creation
    - sysmon
    - collection
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"1" AND (data_win_eventdata_description:/.*7-[Zz][Ii][Pp].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\7[Zz]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\7[Zz][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\7[Zz][Aa]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_originalFileName:/7[Zz]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_originalFileName:/7[Zz][Aa]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_originalFileName:/7[Zz][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/) AND (data_win_eventdata_commandLine:/.*\.[Dd][Mm][Pp].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_commandLine:/.*\.[Dd][Uu][Mm][Pp].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_commandLine:/.*\.[Hh][Dd][Mm][Pp].*/)

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_01_process_creation/windows_odbcconf_load_dll.yaml
cases.input:
name: Windows Odbcconf Load DLL
id: Windows-Odbcconf-Load-DLL
version: 8
schema_version: 1
date: '2025-05-02'
author: SOCFortress LLC
status: production
type: TTP
description: >
  Detects odbcconf.exe executing with the /A or -A flag combined with the REGSVR
  action to load a DLL. Attackers abuse this LOLBAS technique to proxy DLL
  execution through a trusted Windows binary, bypassing application whitelisting
  and evading defenses. This is the targeted TTP companion to the broad odbcconf
  hunting detection. Associated with Living Off The Land tradecraft.
  MITRE ATT&CK: T1218.008 (System Binary Proxy Execution: Odbcconf).

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 1 (ProcessCreate)

search:
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "AGENT_NAME"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "CUSTOMER_CODE"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "1"
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_image: "*\\odbcconf.exe"
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_commandLine: "*/a *"
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_commandLine: "*-a *"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_commandLine: "*regsvr*"
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "START_TIME"
              lte: "END_TIME"

parameters:
  - name: AGENT_NAME
    default: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  - name: CUSTOMER_CODE
    default: "lab"
  - name: START_TIME
    default: "now-24h"
  - name: END_TIME
    default: "now"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 1 (ProcessCreate) flowing to the Wazuh Indexer.
  Fields data_win_eventdata_image and data_win_eventdata_commandLine are
  confirmed working across all EventID 1 detections in this environment.
  Field-validated based on established EventID 1 detection patterns.

known_false_positives: >
  False positives may be present based on legitimate ODBC driver registration.
  Filter based on known approved software or paths as needed.

references:
  - https://strontic.github.io/xcyclopedia/library/odbcconf.exe-07FBA12552331355C103999806627314.html
  - https://twitter.com/redcanary/status/1541838407894171650
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/008/

response:
  message: >
    odbcconf.exe loading DLL via REGSVR action detected on $agent_name$ by $data_win_eventdata_user$.
    Parent: $data_win_eventdata_parentImage$.
    Command: $data_win_eventdata_commandLine$.
    MITRE ATT&CK: T1218.008
  risk_score: 42
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 42
    - field: data_win_eventdata_user
      type: user
      score: 42
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_parentImage
      type: parent_process_name
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process_name

tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Living Off The Land
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1218.008
  custom_tags:
    - odbcconf
    - regsvr
    - dll_load
    - lolbas
    - proxy_execution
    - defense_evasion
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_03_network_connection/communication_to_localtonet_tunneling_service_initiated.yaml
cases.input:
name: Communication To LocaltoNet Tunneling Service Initiated
id: 3ab65069-d82a-4d44-a759-466661a082d1
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2024-06-17"
author: Andreas Braathen (mnemonic.io)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 3ab65069-d82a-4d44-a759-466661a082d1
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects an executable initiating a network connection to "LocaltoNet"
  tunneling sub-domains. LocaltoNet is a reverse proxy that enables localhost
  services to be exposed to the Internet. Attackers have been seen to use this
  service for command-and-control activities to bypass MFA and perimeter
  controls. MITRE ATT&CK: T1572, T1090, T1102.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 3 - Network Connection

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "3"
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname:
                    value: "*.localto.net"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname:
                    value: "*.localtonet.com"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - term:
            data_win_eventdata_initiated:
              value: "true"
              case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname
    - data_win_eventdata_initiated
    - data_win_eventdata_image
    - data_win_eventdata_destinationIp
    - data_win_eventdata_destinationPort
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 3 (network connection) enabled in the Sysmon
  configuration and the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected
  by the Wazuh agent. The detection looks for events where
  data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname matches '*.localto.net';
  data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname matches '*.localtonet.com';
  data_win_eventdata_initiated equals 'true'.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate use of the LocaltoNet service. Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - https://localtonet.com/documents/supported-tunnels
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/unc3944-targets-saas-applications
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1090/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1102/

response:
  message: >
    Communication To LocaltoNet Tunneling Service Initiated detected on host
    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname:
    $data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_initiated: $data_win_eventdata_initiated$. MITRE ATT&CK:
    T1572, T1090, T1102
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_destinationHostname
      type: domain
    - field: data_win_eventdata_initiated
      type: other

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1572
    - T1090
    - T1102

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_06_driver_loaded/driver_load_from_a_temporary_directory.yaml
cases.input:
name: Driver Load From A Temporary Directory
id: 2c4523d5-d481-4ed0-8ec3-7fbf0cb41a75
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2021-11-27"
author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 2c4523d5-d481-4ed0-8ec3-7fbf0cb41a75
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects a driver load from a temporary directory. MITRE ATT&CK: T1543.003.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 6 - Driver Loaded

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "6"
        
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:
              value: "*\\\\Temp\\\\*"
              case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded
    - data_win_eventdata_signature
    - data_win_eventdata_hashes

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 6 (driver loaded) and the
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent. The
  detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded matches
  '*\Temp\*'.

known_false_positives: >
  There is a relevant set of false positives depending on applications in the
  environment. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - Internal Research
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1543/003/

response:
  message: >
    Driver Load From A Temporary Directory detected on host $agent_name$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded: $data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_signature: $data_win_eventdata_signature$. MITRE
    ATT&CK: T1543.003
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded
      type: process
    - field: data_win_eventdata_signature
      type: other

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1543.003
  custom_tags:
    - driver
    - temporary
    - directory
    - driver_load
    - sysmon
    - persistence
    - privilege_escalation
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"6" AND data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:/.*\\[Tt][Ee][Mm][Pp]\\.*/

version: 1

date: "2023-07-11"
author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

  format: sigma

  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects potential DLL sideloading of DLLs that are known to be abused from
  suspicious locations. MITRE ATT&CK: T1059.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 7 - Image Loaded

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:

        - term:

                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:

                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:

                    case_insensitive: true

                    value: "*\\\\ZIPDLL.dll"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - bool:
            should:

                    value: "*:\\\\Perflogs\\\\*"

              - wildcard:

                    value: "*:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\*"

                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:
                          value: "*\\\\Favorites\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true

                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:
                          value: "*:\\\\Users\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:
                          value: "*\\\\Favourites\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true

                        data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:
                          value: "*:\\\\Users\\\\*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_imageLoaded:

                          case_insensitive: true

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_08_create_remote_thread/hacktool_cactustorch_remote_thread_creation.yaml
cases.input:
name: HackTool - CACTUSTORCH Remote Thread Creation
id: 2e4e488a-6164-4811-9ea1-f960c7359c40
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2023-05-05"
author: "@SBousseaden (detection), Thomas Patzke (rule)"
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 2e4e488a-6164-4811-9ea1-f960c7359c40
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects remote thread creation from CACTUSTORCH as described in references.
  MITRE ATT&CK: T1055.012, T1059.005, T1059.007, T1218.005.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 8 - CreateRemoteThread

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "8"
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:
                    value: "*\\\\System32\\\\cscript.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:
                    value: "*\\\\System32\\\\wscript.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:
                    value: "*\\\\System32\\\\mshta.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:
                    value: "*\\\\winword.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:
                    value: "*\\\\excel.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_targetImage:
              value: "*\\\\SysWOW64\\\\*"
              case_insensitive: true
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - exists:
                  field: "data_win_eventdata_startModule"
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_sourceImage
    - data_win_eventdata_targetImage
    - data_win_eventdata_startModule

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 8 (CreateRemoteThread) enabled in the Sysmon
  configuration and the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected
  by the Wazuh agent. The detection looks for events where
  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage matches '*\System32\cscript.exe';
  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage matches '*\System32\wscript.exe';
  data_win_eventdata_sourceImage matches '*\System32\mshta.exe', among other
  conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Unknown. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://twitter.com/SBousseaden/status/1090588499517079552
  - https://github.com/mdsecactivebreach/CACTUSTORCH
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1055/012/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/005/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/007/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/005/

response:
  message: >
    HackTool - CACTUSTORCH Remote Thread Creation detected on host $agent_name$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_sourceImage: $data_win_eventdata_sourceImage$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_targetImage: $data_win_eventdata_targetImage$.
    MITRE ATT&CK: T1055.012, T1059.005, T1059.007, T1218.005
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_sourceImage
      type: process
    - field: data_win_eventdata_targetImage
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1055.012
    - T1059.005
    - T1059.007
    - T1218.005
  custom_tags:
    - hacktool
    - cactustorch
    - thread
    - create_remote_thread
    - sysmon
    - privilege_escalation
    - execution
    - stealth
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"8" AND (data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:/.*\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Cc][Ss][Cc][Rr][Ii][Pp][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:/.*\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Ww][Ss][Cc][Rr][Ii][Pp][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:/.*\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Mm][Ss][Hh][Tt][Aa]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:/.*\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Ww][Oo][Rr][Dd]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_sourceImage:/.*\\[Ee][Xx][Cc][Ee][Ll]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/) AND data_win_eventdata_targetImage:/.*\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Ww][Oo][Ww]64\\.*/ AND NOT _exists_:data_win_eventdata_startModule

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_10_process_access/cmstp_execution_process_access.yaml
cases.input:
name: CMSTP Execution Process Access
id: 3b4b232a-af90-427c-a22f-30b0c0837b95
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2021-06-27"
author: Nik Seetharaman
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 3b4b232a-af90-427c-a22f-30b0c0837b95
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: production
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects various indicators of Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer
  execution. MITRE ATT&CK: T1218.003, T1559.001.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 10 - Process Access

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "10"
        
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_callTrace:
              value: "*cmlua.dll*"
              case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_callTrace
    - data_win_eventdata_sourceImage
    - data_win_eventdata_targetImage
    - data_win_eventdata_grantedAccess

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 10 (process access) enabled in the Sysmon
  configuration for the monitored target processes and the
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent. The
  detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_callTrace matches
  '*cmlua.dll*'.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate CMSTP use (unlikely in modern enterprise environments). Baseline
  expected activity in your environment and tune this detection before relying
  on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://web.archive.org/web/20190720093911/http://www.endurant.io/cmstp/detecting-cmstp-enabled-code-execution-and-uac-bypass-with-sysmon/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/003/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1559/001/

response:
  message: >
    CMSTP Execution Process Access detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_callTrace: $data_win_eventdata_callTrace$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_sourceImage: $data_win_eventdata_sourceImage$. MITRE
    ATT&CK: T1218.003, T1559.001
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_callTrace
      type: other
    - field: data_win_eventdata_sourceImage
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1218.003
    - T1559.001
  custom_tags:
    - cmstp
    - process_access
    - sysmon
    - stealth
    - execution
    - g0069
    - g0080
    - car_2019_04_001
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"10" AND data_win_eventdata_callTrace:/.*[Cc][Mm][Ll][Uu][Aa]\.[Dd][Ll][Ll].*/

cases.input:
name: ADExplorer Writing Complete AD Snapshot Into .dat File
id: 0a1255c5-d732-4b62-ac02-b5152d34fb83
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2025-07-09"
author: Arnim Rupp (Nextron Systems), Thomas Patzke
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 0a1255c5-d732-4b62-ac02-b5152d34fb83
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects the dual use tool ADExplorer writing a complete AD snapshot into a
  .dat file. This can be used by attackers to extract data for Bloodhound,
  usernames for password spraying or use the meta data for social engineering.
  The snapshot doesn't contain password hashes but there have been cases, where
  administrators put passwords in the comment field. MITRE ATT&CK: T1087.002,
  T1069.002, T1482.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 11 - File Created

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "11"
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_image:
                    value: "*\\\\ADExp.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_image:
                    value: "*\\\\ADExplorer.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_image:
                    value: "*\\\\ADExplorer64.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_image:
                    value: "*\\\\ADExplorer64a.exe"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_targetFilename:
              value: "*.dat"
              case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_image
    - data_win_eventdata_targetFilename
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"

cases.input:
name: Atbroker Registry Change
id: 9577edbb-851f-4243-8c91-1d5b50c1a39b
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2023-01-19"
author: Mateusz Wydra, oscd.community
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 9577edbb-851f-4243-8c91-1d5b50c1a39b
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects creation/modification of Assistive Technology applications and
  persistence with usage of 'at'. MITRE ATT&CK: T1218, T1547.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 12/13/14 - Registry Events

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - bool:
            should:
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "12"
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "13"
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "14"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_targetObject:
                    value: "*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\ATs*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_targetObject:
                    value: "*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\Configuration*"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_image"
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_targetObject"
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_details"
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - bool:
                  should:
                    - bool:
                        must:
                          - term:
                              data_win_eventdata_image:
                                value: "C:\\Windows\\system32\\atbroker.exe"
                                case_insensitive: true
                          - wildcard:
                              data_win_eventdata_targetObject:
                                value: "*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\Configuration*"
                                case_insensitive: true
                          - term:
                              data_win_eventdata_details:
                                value: "(Empty)"
                                case_insensitive: true
                    - bool:
                        must:
                          - wildcard:
                              data_win_eventdata_image:
                                value: "C:\\\\Windows\\\\Installer\\\\MSI*"
                                case_insensitive: true
                          - wildcard:
                              data_win_eventdata_targetObject:
                                value: "*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\ATs*"
                                case_insensitive: true
                  minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_targetObject
    - data_win_eventdata_image
    - data_win_eventdata_details

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon registry event logging (EventIDs 12/13/14) enabled in the
  Sysmon configuration for the monitored keys and the
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent. The
  detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_targetObject matches
  '*Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Accessibility\ATs*';
  data_win_eventdata_targetObject matches '*Software\Microsoft\Windows
  NT\CurrentVersion\Accessibility\Configuration*'; data_win_eventdata_image
  equals 'C:\Windows\system32\atbroker.exe', among other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Creation of non-default, legitimate at usage. Baseline expected activity in
  your environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - http://www.hexacorn.com/blog/2016/07/22/beyond-good-ol-run-key-part-42/
  - https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Binaries/Atbroker/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/

response:
  message: >
    Atbroker Registry Change detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_targetObject: $data_win_eventdata_targetObject$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_image: $data_win_eventdata_image$. MITRE ATT&CK: T1218,
    T1547
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_targetObject
      type: registry_key
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1218
    - T1547
  custom_tags:
    - atbroker
    - registry
    - change
    - sysmon
    - privilege_escalation
    - stealth
    - persistence
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: (data_win_system_eventID:"12" OR data_win_system_eventID:"13" OR data_win_system_eventID:"14") AND (data_win_eventdata_targetObject:/.*[Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt][Ww][Aa][Rr][Ee]\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss] [Nn][Tt]\\[Cc][Uu][Rr][Rr][Ee][Nn][Tt][Vv][Ee][Rr][Ss][Ii][Oo][Nn]\\[Aa][Cc][Cc][Ee][Ss][Ss][Ii][Bb][Ii][Ll][Ii][Tt][Yy]\\[Aa][Tt][Ss].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_targetObject:/.*[Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt][Ww][Aa][Rr][Ee]\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss] [Nn][Tt]\\[Cc][Uu][Rr][Rr][Ee][Nn][Tt][Vv][Ee][Rr][Ss][Ii][Oo][Nn]\\[Aa][Cc][Cc][Ee][Ss][Ss][Ii][Bb][Ii][Ll][Ii][Tt][Yy]\\[Cc][Oo][Nn][Ff][Ii][Gg][Uu][Rr][Aa][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn].*/) AND _exists_:data_win_eventdata_image AND _exists_:data_win_eventdata_targetObject AND _exists_:data_win_eventdata_details AND NOT ((data_win_eventdata_image:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Aa][Tt][Bb][Rr][Oo][Kk][Ee][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ AND data_win_eventdata_targetObject:/.*\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss] [Nn][Tt]\\[Cc][Uu][Rr][Rr][Ee][Nn][Tt][Vv][Ee][Rr][Ss][Ii][Oo][Nn]\\[Aa][Cc][Cc][Ee][Ss][Ss][Ii][Bb][Ii][Ll][Ii][Tt][Yy]\\[Cc][Oo][Nn][Ff][Ii][Gg][Uu][Rr][Aa][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn].*/ AND data_win_eventdata_details:/\([Ee][Mm][Pp][Tt][Yy]\)/) OR (data_win_eventdata_image:/[Cc]:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ii][Nn][Ss][Tt][Aa][Ll][Ll][Ee][Rr]\\[Mm][Ss][Ii].*/ AND data_win_eventdata_targetObject:/.*[Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt][Ww][Aa][Rr][Ee]\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss] [Nn][Tt]\\[Cc][Uu][Rr][Rr][Ee][Nn][Tt][Vv][Ee][Rr][Ss][Ii][Oo][Nn]\\[Aa][Cc][Cc][Ee][Ss][Ss][Ii][Bb][Ii][Ll][Ii][Tt][Yy]\\[Aa][Tt][Ss].*/))

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_12_registry_key_created_deleted/delete_defender_scan_shellex_context_menu_registry_key.yaml
cases.input:
name: Delete Defender Scan ShellEx Context Menu Registry Key
id: 72a0369a-2576-4aaf-bfc9-6bb24a574ac6
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2025-10-07"
author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 72a0369a-2576-4aaf-bfc9-6bb24a574ac6
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects deletion of registry key that adds 'Scan with Defender' option in
  context menu. Attackers may use this to make it harder for users to scan files
  that are suspicious.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 12 - Registry Key Deleted

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "12"
        
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_targetObject:
              value: "*shellex\\\\ContextMenuHandlers\\\\EPP*"
              case_insensitive: true
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_image"
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - bool:
                  must:
                    - bool:
                        should:
                          - wildcard:
                              data_win_eventdata_image:
                                value: "C:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows Defender\\\\Platform\\\\*"
                                case_insensitive: true
                          - wildcard:
                              data_win_eventdata_image:
                                value: "C:\\\\Program Files\\\\Windows Defender\\\\*"
                                case_insensitive: true
                          - wildcard:
                              data_win_eventdata_image:
                                value: "C:\\\\Program Files (x86)\\\\Windows Defender\\\\*"
                                case_insensitive: true
                        minimum_should_match: 1
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*\\\\MsMpEng.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_targetObject
    - data_win_eventdata_image

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon registry event logging (EventIDs 12/13/14) enabled in the
  Sysmon configuration for the monitored keys and the
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent. The
  detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_targetObject matches
  '*shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\EPP*'; data_win_eventdata_image matches
  'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Platform\*';
  data_win_eventdata_image matches 'C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\*', among
  other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Unlikely as this weakens defenses and normally would not be done even if using
  another AV. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://research.splunk.com/endpoint/395ed5fe-ad13-4366-9405-a228427bdd91/
  - https://winaero.com/how-to-delete-scan-with-windows-defender-from-context-menu-in-windows-10/
  - https://thedfirreport.com/2021/10/18/icedid-to-xinglocker-ransomware-in-24-hours/
  - https://blog.malwarebytes.com/malwarebytes-news/2021/02/lazyscripter-from-empire-to-double-rat/

response:
  message: >
    Delete Defender Scan ShellEx Context Menu Registry Key detected on host
    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_eventdata_targetObject:
    $data_win_eventdata_targetObject$. Matched data_win_eventdata_image:
    $data_win_eventdata_image$.
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_targetObject
      type: registry_key
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  custom_tags:
    - delete
    - defender
    - shellex
    - registry
    - sysmon
    - defense_impairment
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"12" AND data_win_eventdata_targetObject:/.*[Ss][Hh][Ee][Ll][Ll][Ee][Xx]\\[Cc][Oo][Nn][Tt][Ee][Xx][Tt][Mm][Ee][Nn][Uu][Hh][Aa][Nn][Dd][Ll][Ee][Rr][Ss]\\[Ee][Pp][Pp].*/ AND _exists_:data_win_eventdata_image AND NOT ((data_win_eventdata_image:/[Cc]:\\[Pp][Rr][Oo][Gg][Rr][Aa][Mm][Dd][Aa][Tt][Aa]\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss] [Dd][Ee][Ff][Ee][Nn][Dd][Ee][Rr]\\[Pp][Ll][Aa][Tt][Ff][Oo][Rr][Mm]\\.*/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/[Cc]:\\[Pp][Rr][Oo][Gg][Rr][Aa][Mm] [Ff][Ii][Ll][Ee][Ss]\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss] [Dd][Ee][Ff][Ee][Nn][Dd][Ee][Rr]\\.*/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/[Cc]:\\[Pp][Rr][Oo][Gg][Rr][Aa][Mm] [Ff][Ii][Ll][Ee][Ss] \([Xx]86\)\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss] [Dd][Ee][Ff][Ee][Nn][Dd][Ee][Rr]\\.*/) AND data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Mm][Ss][Mm][Pp][Ee][Nn][Gg]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/)

cases.input:
name: Activate Suppression of Windows Security Center Notifications
id: 0c93308a-3f1b-40a9-b649-57ea1a1c1d63
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2023-08-17"
author: frack113
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 0c93308a-3f1b-40a9-b649-57ea1a1c1d63
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detect set Notification_Suppress to 1 to disable the Windows security center
  notification. MITRE ATT&CK: T1112.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 13 - Registry Value Set

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "13"

cases.input:
name: Windows New Default File Association Value Set
id: Windows-New-Default-File-Association-Value-Set
version: 3
schema_version: 1
date: '2025-05-02'
author: SOCFortress LLC
status: production
type: Hunting
description: >
  Detects registry modifications to default file association handlers under
  HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\*\shell\open\command. Attackers modify these values to
  execute arbitrary scripts or payloads when a user opens a file with a given
  extension, enabling persistence and code execution. Associated with Hermetic
  Wiper, Prestige Ransomware, Windows Privilege Escalation, and Windows
  Persistence Techniques tradecraft.
  MITRE ATT&CK: T1546.001 (Event Triggered Execution: Change Default File Association).

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 13 (RegistryEvent Value Set)

search:
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "AGENT_NAME"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "CUSTOMER_CODE"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "13"
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_targetObject: "*\\shell\\open\\command\\*"
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_targetObject: "*HKCR\\*"
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_targetObject: "*HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\\*"
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_targetObject: "*Classes\\*\\shell\\open\\command\\*"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "START_TIME"
              lte: "END_TIME"

parameters:
  - name: AGENT_NAME
    default: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  - name: CUSTOMER_CODE
    default: "lab"
  - name: START_TIME
    default: "now-24h"
  - name: END_TIME
    default: "now"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 13 (RegistryEvent Value Set) flowing to the Wazuh Indexer.
  Field data_win_eventdata_targetObject is confirmed working across all EventID 13
  detections in this environment. Field-validated based on established EventID 13
  detection patterns. Note: HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT paths may appear as HKCR or as
  HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes in Sysmon telemetry depending on the context
  (system vs user hive). Consider also monitoring
  *HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes\*\shell\open\command* for broader coverage.

known_false_positives: >
  Windows and third-party software will create and modify file associations during
  installation or upgrades. Additional filters should be applied to tune
  environment-specific false positives, particularly around known software
  installers and update processes.

references:
  - https://dmcxblue.gitbook.io/red-team-notes-2-0/red-team-techniques/privilege-escalation/untitled-3/accessibility-features
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/001/

response:
  message: >
    Default file association registry value modified on $agent_name$ by $data_win_eventdata_user$.
    Registry path: $data_win_eventdata_targetObject$.
    Value set: $data_win_eventdata_details$.
    MITRE ATT&CK: T1546.001
  risk_score: 40
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 40
    - field: data_win_eventdata_user
      type: user
      score: 40
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_targetObject
      type: registry_path

tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Hermetic Wiper
    - Windows Registry Abuse
    - Prestige Ransomware
    - Windows Privilege Escalation
    - Windows Persistence Techniques
    - Data Destruction
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1546.001
  custom_tags:
    - file_association
    - shell_open_command
    - hkcr
    - persistence
    - registry
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

                    case_insensitive: true

                    case_insensitive: true

                    case_insensitive: true

                    case_insensitive: true

                    case_insensitive: true

                  data_win_eventdata_targetFilename:
                    value: "*.wsc*"
                    case_insensitive: true

                  data_win_eventdata_targetFilename:
                    value: "*.wsf*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:

                    case_insensitive: true

        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_image"

                          case_insensitive: true

                          case_insensitive: true

                          case_insensitive: true

                          case_insensitive: true

                          case_insensitive: true

                                      case_insensitive: true

                                      value: "C:\\\\Program Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\*"
                                      case_insensitive: true

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon file creation logging (EventID 11) enabled in the Sysmon
  configuration for the monitored paths and the
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent. The
  detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_contents matches
  '[ZoneTransfer] ZoneId=3*'; data_win_eventdata_targetFilename matches
  '*:Zone.Identifier'; data_win_eventdata_targetFilename matches '*.exe*', among
  other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Other legitimate browsers not currently included in the filter (please add
  them). Legitimate downloads via scripting or command-line tools (Investigate
  to determine if it's legitimate). Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:

    $data_win_eventdata_targetFilename$.

    - field: data_win_eventdata_targetFilename

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_16_sysmon_config_changed/sysmon_configuration_change.yaml
cases.input:
name: Sysmon Configuration Change
id: 8ac03a65-6c84-4116-acad-dc1558ff7a77
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2022-01-12"
author: frack113
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 8ac03a65-6c84-4116-acad-dc1558ff7a77
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects a Sysmon configuration change, which could be the result of a
  legitimate reconfiguration or someone trying manipulate the configuration.

data_source:
  - Sysmon Event Log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "16"
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_image

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon installed with a configuration that enables the relevant event
  type and the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the
  Wazuh agent (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf). The detection looks
  for events where data_win_system_eventID equals '16'.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate administrative action. Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/sysmon

response:
  message: >
    Sysmon Configuration Change detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_image: $data_win_eventdata_image$.
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  custom_tags:
    - sysmon
    - configuration
    - change
    - defense_impairment
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"16"
