cases.label: rule file detections/eid_17_18_pipe_events/adfs_database_named_pipe_connection_by_uncommon_tool.yaml
cases.input:
name: ADFS Database Named Pipe Connection By Uncommon Tool
id: 1ea13e8c-03ea-409b-877d-ce5c3d2c1cb3
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2023-11-30"
author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 1ea13e8c-03ea-409b-877d-ce5c3d2c1cb3
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects suspicious local connections via a named pipe to the AD FS
  configuration database (Windows Internal Database). Used to access information
  such as the AD FS configuration settings which contains sensitive information
  used to sign SAML tokens. MITRE ATT&CK: T1005.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 17/18 - Named Pipe

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - bool:
            should:
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "17"
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "18"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        
        - term:
            data_win_eventdata_pipeName:
              value: "\\MICROSOFT##WID\\tsql\\query"
              case_insensitive: true
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_image"
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - bool:
                  should:
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\mmc.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\svchost.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wsmprovhost.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\mmc.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\wsmprovhost.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*:\\\\Windows\\\\WID\\\\Binn\\\\sqlwriter.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*\\\\AzureADConnect.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*\\\\Microsoft.Identity.Health.Adfs.PshSurrogate.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*\\\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*\\\\Microsoft.Tri.Sensor.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*\\\\sqlservr.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "*\\\\tssdis.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                  minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_pipeName
    - data_win_eventdata_image

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon named pipe logging (EventIDs 17/18) enabled in the Sysmon
  configuration and the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected
  by the Wazuh agent. The detection looks for events where
  data_win_eventdata_pipeName equals '\MICROSOFT##WID\tsql\query';
  data_win_eventdata_image matches '*:\Windows\System32\mmc.exe';
  data_win_eventdata_image matches '*:\Windows\system32\svchost.exe', among
  other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Unknown. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/f99542b94afe0ad2f19a82cc08262e7ac8e1428e/Detections/SecurityEvent/ADFSDBNamedPipeConnection.yaml
  - https://o365blog.com/post/adfs/
  - https://github.com/Azure/SimuLand
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1005/

response:
  message: >
    ADFS Database Named Pipe Connection By Uncommon Tool detected on host
    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_eventdata_pipeName:
    $data_win_eventdata_pipeName$. Matched data_win_eventdata_image:
    $data_win_eventdata_image$. MITRE ATT&CK: T1005
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_pipeName
      type: pipe
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1005
  custom_tags:
    - database
    - named
    - connection
    - pipe_created
    - sysmon
    - collection
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: (data_win_system_eventID:"17" OR data_win_system_eventID:"18") AND data_win_eventdata_pipeName:/\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\#\#[Ww][Ii][Dd]\\[Tt][Ss][Qq][Ll]\\[Qq][Uu][Ee][Rr][Yy]/ AND _exists_:data_win_eventdata_image AND NOT (data_win_eventdata_image:/.*:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Mm][Mm][Cc]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Ss][Vv][Cc][Hh][Oo][Ss][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Tt][Ee][Mm]32\\[Ww][Ss][Mm][Pp][Rr][Oo][Vv][Hh][Oo][Ss][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Ww][Oo][Ww]64\\[Mm][Mm][Cc]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ss][Yy][Ss][Ww][Oo][Ww]64\\[Ww][Ss][Mm][Pp][Rr][Oo][Vv][Hh][Oo][Ss][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*:\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss]\\[Ww][Ii][Dd]\\[Bb][Ii][Nn][Nn]\\[Ss][Qq][Ll][Ww][Rr][Ii][Tt][Ee][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Aa][Zz][Uu][Rr][Ee][Aa][Dd][Cc][Oo][Nn][Nn][Ee][Cc][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\.[Ii][Dd][Ee][Nn][Tt][Ii][Tt][Yy]\.[Hh][Ee][Aa][Ll][Tt][Hh]\.[Aa][Dd][Ff][Ss]\.[Pp][Ss][Hh][Ss][Uu][Rr][Rr][Oo][Gg][Aa][Tt][Ee]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\.[Ii][Dd][Ee][Nn][Tt][Ii][Tt][Yy][Ss][Ee][Rr][Vv][Ee][Rr]\.[Ss][Ee][Rr][Vv][Ii][Cc][Ee][Hh][Oo][Ss][Tt]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\.[Tt][Rr][Ii]\.[Ss][Ee][Nn][Ss][Oo][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Ss][Qq][Ll][Ss][Ee][Rr][Vv][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/ OR data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Tt][Ss][Ss][Dd][Ii][Ss]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/)

cases.input:
name: Suspicious Encoded Scripts in a WMI Consumer
id: 83844185-1c5b-45bc-bcf3-b5bf3084ca5b
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2022-10-09"
author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 83844185-1c5b-45bc-bcf3-b5bf3084ca5b
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects suspicious encoded payloads in WMI Event Consumers. MITRE ATT&CK:
  T1047, T1546.003.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 19/20/21 - WMI Event

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - bool:
            should:
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "19"
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "20"
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "21"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*V3JpdGVQcm9jZXNzTWVtb3J5*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*dyaXRlUHJvY2Vzc01lbW9ye*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*Xcml0ZVByb2Nlc3NNZW1vcn*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*VGhpcyBwcm9ncmFtIGNhbm5vdCBiZSBydW4gaW4gRE9TIG1vZG*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*RoaXMgcHJvZ3JhbSBjYW5ub3QgYmUgcnVuIGluIERPUyBtb2Rl*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*UaGlzIHByb2dyYW0gY2Fubm90IGJlIHJ1biBpbiBET1MgbW9kZ*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*VGhpcyBwcm9ncmFtIG11c3QgYmUgcnVuIHVuZGVyIFdpbjMy*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*RoaXMgcHJvZ3JhbSBtdXN0IGJlIHJ1biB1bmRlciBXaW4zM*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_destination:
                    value: "*UaGlzIHByb2dyYW0gbXVzdCBiZSBydW4gdW5kZXIgV2luMz*"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_destination
    - data_win_eventdata_operation
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon WMI event logging (EventIDs 19/20/21) enabled in the Sysmon
  configuration and the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected
  by the Wazuh agent. The detection looks for events where
  data_win_eventdata_destination matches '*V3JpdGVQcm9jZXNzTWVtb3J5*';
  data_win_eventdata_destination matches '*dyaXRlUHJvY2Vzc01lbW9ye*';
  data_win_eventdata_destination matches '*Xcml0ZVByb2Nlc3NNZW1vcn*', among
  other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Unknown. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://github.com/RiccardoAncarani/LiquidSnake
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1047/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/003/

response:
  message: >
    Suspicious Encoded Scripts in a WMI Consumer detected on host $agent_name$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_destination: $data_win_eventdata_destination$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_operation: $data_win_eventdata_operation$. MITRE
    ATT&CK: T1047, T1546.003
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_destination
      type: other
    - field: data_win_eventdata_operation
      type: operation

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1047
    - T1546.003
  custom_tags:
    - encoded
    - consumer
    - wmi_event
    - sysmon
    - privilege_escalation
    - execution
    - persistence
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: (data_win_system_eventID:"19" OR data_win_system_eventID:"20" OR data_win_system_eventID:"21") AND (data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Vv]3[Jj][Pp][Dd][Gg][Vv][Qq][Cc][Mm]9[Jj][Zz][Xx][Nn][Zz][Tt][Ww][Vv][Tt][Bb]3[Jj]5.*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Dd][Yy][Aa][Xx][Rr][Ll][Uu][Hh][Jj][Vv][Yy]2[Vv][Zz][Cc]01[Ll][Bb][Ww]9[Yy][Ee].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Xx][Cc][Mm][Ll]0[Zz][Vv][Bb][Yy][Bb]2[Nn][Ll][Cc]3[Nn][Nn][Zz][Ww]1[Vv][Cc][Nn].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Vv][Gg][Hh][Pp][Cc][Yy][Bb][Ww][Cc][Mm]9[Nn][Cc][Mm][Ff][Tt][Ii][Gg][Nn][Hh][Bb][Mm]5[Vv][Dd][Cc][Bb][Ii][Zz][Ss][Bb][Yy][Dd][Ww]4[Gg][Aa][Ww]4[Gg][Rr][Ee]9[Tt][Ii][Gg]1[Vv][Zz][Gg].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Rr][Oo][Aa][Xx][Mm][Gg][Cc][Hh][Jj][Vv][Zz]3[Jj][Hh][Bb][Ss][Bb][Jj][Yy][Ww]5[Uu][Bb]3[Qq][Gg][Yy][Mm][Uu][Gg][Cc][Nn][Vv][Uu][Ii][Gg][Ll][Uu][Ii][Ee][Rr][Pp][Uu][Yy][Bb][Tt][Bb]2[Rr][Ll].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Uu][Aa][Gg][Ll][Zz][Ii][Hh][Bb][Yy][Bb]2[Dd][Yy][Yy][Ww]0[Gg][Yy]2[Ff][Uu][Bb][Mm]90[Ii][Gg][Jj][Ll][Ii][Hh][Jj]1[Bb][Ii][Bb][Pp][Bb][Ii][Bb][Ee][Tt]1[Mm][Gg][Bb][Ww]9[Kk][Zz].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Vv][Gg][Hh][Pp][Cc][Yy][Bb][Ww][Cc][Mm]9[Nn][Cc][Mm][Ff][Tt][Ii][Gg]11[Cc]3[Qq][Gg][Yy][Mm][Uu][Gg][Cc][Nn][Vv][Uu][Ii][Hh][Vv][Uu][Zz][Gg][Vv][Yy][Ii][Ff][Dd][Pp][Bb][Jj][Mm][Yy].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Rr][Oo][Aa][Xx][Mm][Gg][Cc][Hh][Jj][Vv][Zz]3[Jj][Hh][Bb][Ss][Bb][Tt][Dd][Xx][Nn]0[Ii][Gg][Jj][Ll][Ii][Hh][Jj]1[Bb][Ii][Bb]1[Bb][Mm][Rr][Ll][Cc][Ii][Bb][Xx][Aa][Ww]4[Zz][Mm].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_destination:/.*[Uu][Aa][Gg][Ll][Zz][Ii][Hh][Bb][Yy][Bb]2[Dd][Yy][Yy][Ww]0[Gg][Bb][Xx][Vv][Zz][Dd][Cc][Bb][Ii][Zz][Ss][Bb][Yy][Dd][Ww]4[Gg][Dd][Ww]5[Kk][Zz][Xx][Ii][Gg][Vv]2[Ll][Uu][Mm][Zz].*/)

cases.label: rule file detections/eid_22_dns_query/appx_package_installation_attempts_via_appinstaller_exe.yaml
cases.input:
name: AppX Package Installation Attempts Via AppInstaller.EXE
id: 7cff77e1-9663-46a3-8260-17f2e1aa9d0a
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2023-11-09"
author: frack113
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 7cff77e1-9663-46a3-8260-17f2e1aa9d0a
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects DNS queries made by "AppInstaller.EXE". The AppInstaller is the
  default handler for the "ms-appinstaller" URI. It attempts to load/install a
  package from the referenced URL. MITRE ATT&CK: T1105.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 22 - DNS Query

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "22"
        
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_image:
              value: "C:\\\\Program Files\\\\WindowsApps\\\\Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_*"
              case_insensitive: true
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_image:
              value: "*\\\\AppInstaller.exe"
              case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_image
    - data_win_eventdata_queryName

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon EventID 22 (DNS query) enabled in the Sysmon configuration and
  the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent.
  The detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_image matches
  'C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_*';
  data_win_eventdata_image matches '*\AppInstaller.exe'.

known_false_positives: >
  Unknown. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://twitter.com/notwhickey/status/1333900137232523264
  - https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Binaries/AppInstaller/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1105/

response:
  message: >
    AppX Package Installation Attempts Via AppInstaller.EXE detected on host
    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_eventdata_image: $data_win_eventdata_image$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_queryName: $data_win_eventdata_queryName$. MITRE
    ATT&CK: T1105
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process
    - field: data_win_eventdata_queryName
      type: domain

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1105
  custom_tags:
    - package
    - installation
    - appinstaller
    - dns_query
    - sysmon
    - command_and_control
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"22" AND data_win_eventdata_image:/[Cc]:\\[Pp][Rr][Oo][Gg][Rr][Aa][Mm] [Ff][Ii][Ll][Ee][Ss]\\[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss][Aa][Pp][Pp][Ss]\\[Mm][Ii][Cc][Rr][Oo][Ss][Oo][Ff][Tt]\.[Dd][Ee][Ss][Kk][Tt][Oo][Pp][Aa][Pp][Pp][Ii][Nn][Ss][Tt][Aa][Ll][Ll][Ee][Rr]_.*/ AND data_win_eventdata_image:/.*\\[Aa][Pp][Pp][Ii][Nn][Ss][Tt][Aa][Ll][Ll][Ee][Rr]\.[Ee][Xx][Ee]/

cases.input:
name: ADS Zone.Identifier Deleted By Uncommon Application

converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects the deletion of the "Zone.Identifier" ADS by an uncommon process.
  Attackers can leverage this in order to bypass security restrictions that make
  use of the ADS such as Microsoft Office apps. MITRE ATT&CK: T1070.004.

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 23/26 - File Deleted

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - bool:
            should:
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "23"
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "26"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_targetFilename:
              value: "*:Zone.Identifier"
              case_insensitive: true
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_image"
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - bool:
                  should:
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7-preview\\pwsh.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\explorer.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                  minimum_should_match: 1
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_image"
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - bool:
                  should:
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Mozilla Firefox\\firefox.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files\\Mozilla Firefox\\firefox.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - term:
                        data_win_eventdata_image:
                          value: "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe"
                          case_insensitive: true
                  minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_targetFilename
    - data_win_eventdata_image
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires Sysmon file creation logging (EventID 11) enabled in the Sysmon
  configuration for the monitored paths and the
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent. The
  detection looks for events where data_win_eventdata_targetFilename matches
  '*:Zone.Identifier'; data_win_eventdata_image equals 'C:\Program
  Files\PowerShell\7-preview\pwsh.exe'; data_win_eventdata_image equals
  'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe', among other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Other third party applications not listed. Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - https://securityliterate.com/how-malware-abuses-the-zone-identifier-to-circumvent-detection-and-analysis/
  - Internal Research
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1070/004/

response:

    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_eventdata_targetFilename:
    $data_win_eventdata_targetFilename$. Matched data_win_eventdata_image:
    $data_win_eventdata_image$. MITRE ATT&CK: T1070.004
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_targetFilename
      type: file_name
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process

  custom_tags:
    - identifier
    - deleted
    - uncommon
    - file_delete
    - sysmon
    - stealth
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

name: Sysmon Blocked Executable
id: 23b71bc5-953e-4971-be4c-c896cda73fc2
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2023-09-16"
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 23b71bc5-953e-4971-be4c-c896cda73fc2
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Triggers on any Sysmon "FileBlockExecutable" event, which indicates a
  violation of the configured block policy.

data_source:
  - Sysmon Event Log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "27"
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_image

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"

    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"

    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

  Requires Sysmon installed with a configuration that enables the relevant event
  type and the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational channel collected by the
  Wazuh agent (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf). The detection looks
  for events where data_win_system_eventID equals '27'.

known_false_positives: >
  Unlikely. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://medium.com/@olafhartong/sysmon-14-0-fileblockexecutable-13d7ba3dff3e

response:
  message: >
    Sysmon Blocked Executable detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_image: $data_win_eventdata_image$.
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_image
      type: process

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  custom_tags:
    - sysmon
    - blocked
    - executable
    - defense_impairment
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

cases.input:
name: Alternate PowerShell Hosts - PowerShell Module
id: 64e8e417-c19a-475a-8d19-98ea705394cc
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2025-10-17"
author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 64e8e417-c19a-475a-8d19-98ea705394cc
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects alternate PowerShell hosts potentially bypassing detections looking
  for powershell.exe. MITRE ATT&CK: T1059.001.

data_source:
  - PowerShell Module Logging EventID 4103

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "4103"
        
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_contextInfo: "*"
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_contextInfo"
        - exists:
            field: "data_win_eventdata_payload"
        - bool:
            must_not:
              - bool:
                  should:
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= powershell*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1.0\\\\powershell*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= C:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1.0\\\\powershell*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= C:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= C:/Windows/SysWOW64/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= \\\\\\?\\?\\\\C:Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1.0\\\\powershell*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= \\\\\\?\\?\\\\C:Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1.0\\\\powershell*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*= C:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\System32\\\\sdiagnhost.exe -Embedding*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*ConfigSyncRun.exe*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*C:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\dsac.exe*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_contextInfo:
                          value: "*C:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\wsmprovhost.exe -Embedding*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_payload:
                          value: "*Update-Help*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_payload:
                          value: "*Failed to update Help for the module*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                  minimum_should_match: 1

            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"

cases.input:
name: AADInternals PowerShell Cmdlets Execution - PsScript
id: 91e69562-2426-42ce-a647-711b8152ced6
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2025-02-06"
author: Austin Songer (@austinsonger), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 91e69562-2426-42ce-a647-711b8152ced6
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects ADDInternals Cmdlet execution. A tool for administering Azure AD and
  Office 365. Which can be abused by threat actors to attack Azure AD or Office
  365.

data_source:
  - PowerShell Script Block Logging EventID 4104

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "4104"
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Add-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*ConvertTo-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Disable-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Enable-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Export-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Find-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Get-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Grant-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Initialize-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Install-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Invoke-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Join-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*New-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Open-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Read-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Register-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Remove-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Reset-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Resolve-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Restore-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Save-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Search-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Send-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Set-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Start-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Unprotect-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
                    value: "*Update-AADInt*"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText
    - data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires PowerShell Script Block Logging (EventID 4104) enabled via GPO (Turn
  on PowerShell Script Block Logging) and the
  Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent
  (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf), ingested into the wazuh-*
  indices. The detection looks for events where
  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText matches '*Add-AADInt*';
  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText matches '*ConvertTo-AADInt*';
  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText matches '*Disable-AADInt*', among other
  conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate use of the library for administrative activity. Baseline expected
  activity in your environment and tune this detection before relying on it for
  automated response.

references:
  - https://o365blog.com/aadinternals/
  - https://github.com/Gerenios/AADInternals

response:
  message: >
    AADInternals PowerShell Cmdlets Execution - PsScript detected on host
    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
    $data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId: $data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId$.
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText
      type: powershell_script
    - field: data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId
      type: powershell_script

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  custom_tags:
    - aadinternals
    - powershell
    - cmdlets
    - execution
    - reconnaissance
    - discovery
    - credential_access
    - impact
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"4104" AND (data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Aa][Dd][Dd]-[Aa][Aa][Dd][Ii][Nn][Tt].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Cc][Oo][Nn][Vv][Ee][Rr][Tt][Tt][Oo]-[Aa][Aa][Dd][Ii][Nn][Tt].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Dd][Ii][Ss][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee]-[Aa][Aa][Dd][Ii][Nn][Tt].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Ee][Nn][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee]-[Aa][Aa][Dd][Ii][Nn][Tt].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Ee][Xx][Pp][Oo][Rr][Tt]-[Aa][Aa][Dd][Ii][Nn][Tt].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Ff][Ii][Nn][Dd]-[Aa][Aa][Dd][Ii][Nn][Tt].*/ OR data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Gg][Ee][Tt]-[Aa][Aa][Dd][Ii][Nn][Tt].*/ OR cases.label: rule file detections/eid_4104_script_block_logging/powershell_psattack.yaml
cases.input:
name: PowerShell PSAttack
id: b7ec41a4-042c-4f31-a5db-d0fcde9fa5c5
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2022-12-25"
author: Sean Metcalf (source), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: b7ec41a4-042c-4f31-a5db-d0fcde9fa5c5
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects the use of PSAttack PowerShell hack tool. MITRE ATT&CK: T1059.001.

data_source:
  - PowerShell Script Block Logging EventID 4104

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "4104"
        
        - wildcard:
            data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:
              value: "*PS ATTACK!!!*"
              case_insensitive: true
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText
    - data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires PowerShell Script Block Logging (EventID 4104) enabled via GPO (Turn
  on PowerShell Script Block Logging) and the
  Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational channel collected by the Wazuh agent
  (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf), ingested into the wazuh-*
  indices. The detection looks for events where
  data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText matches '*PS ATTACK!!!*'.

known_false_positives: >
  Unknown. Baseline expected activity in your environment and tune this
  detection before relying on it for automated response.

references:
  - https://adsecurity.org/?p=2921
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/

response:
  message: >
    PowerShell PSAttack detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText: $data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId:
    $data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId$. MITRE ATT&CK: T1059.001
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText
      type: powershell_script
    - field: data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockId
      type: powershell_script

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1059.001
  custom_tags:
    - powershell
    - psattack
    - execution
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"4104" AND data_win_eventdata_scriptBlockText:/.*[Pp][Ss] [Aa][Tt][Tt][Aa][Cc][Kk]!!!.*/

cases.label: rule file detections/multi_event/windows_compatibility_telemetry_tampering_through_registry.yaml
cases.input:
name: Windows Compatibility Telemetry Tampering Through Registry
id: windows-compattelrunner-registry-tampering-001
version: 2
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-02-23"
author: SOCFortress LLC
status: production
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects modifications to the TelemetryController registry key under 
  AppCompatFlags, specifically the Command value. CompatTelRunner.exe runs as 
  SYSTEM and executes whatever is specified in the Command value, making this 
  a powerful persistence and privilege escalation mechanism. Covers both 
  process creation (EventID 1) and registry modification (EventID 13).

data_source:
  - Sysmon EventID 1
  - Sysmon EventID 13

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - bool:
            should:
              - bool:
                  must:
                    - term:
                        data_win_system_eventID: "1"
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_commandLine: "*TelemetryController*"
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_commandLine: "*Command*"
              - bool:
                  must:
                    - term:
                        data_win_system_eventID: "13"
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_targetObject: "*TelemetryController*"
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_targetObject: "*Command*"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_image
    - data_win_eventdata_commandLine
    - data_win_eventdata_targetObject
    - data_win_eventdata_details
    - data_win_eventdata_parentImage
    - data_win_eventdata_user

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-02-23 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-02-23 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  This detection uses two data sources. EventID 1 captures reg.exe commands 
  targeting the TelemetryController path (currently working). EventID 13 
  captures the actual registry value modification (requires adding 
  TelemetryController to Sysmon RegistryEvent include rules). Add to Sysmon 
  config: <TargetObject condition="contains">AppCompatFlags\TelemetryController</TargetObject>

known_false_positives: >
  None identified. Legitimate TelemetryController modifications are performed by 
  Windows Update and should not target custom Command values pointing to 
  user-writable paths.

references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/
  - https://scythe.io/threat-thursday/windows-telemetry-persistence
  - https://www.trustedsec.com/blog/abusing-windows-telemetry-for-persistence

response:
  message: >
    TelemetryController registry tampering on $agent_name$. 
    EventID: $data_win_system_eventID$. 
    Command: $data_win_eventdata_commandLine$. 
    Registry: $data_win_eventdata_targetObject$. 
    Value: $data_win_eventdata_details$. 
    User: $data_win_eventdata_user$. 
    Possible SYSTEM-level persistence. MITRE ATT&CK: T1546
  risk_score: 72
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 72
  threat_objects: []

tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Windows Persistence Techniques
    - Compromised Windows Host
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1546
    - T1053.005
  custom_tags:
    - compattelrunner
    - telemetry_abuse
    - persistence
    - privilege_escalation
    - registry_modification
    - dual_eventid
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: ((data_win_system_eventID:"1" AND data_win_eventdata_commandLine:/.*TelemetryController.*/ AND data_win_eventdata_commandLine:/.*Command.*/) OR (data_win_system_eventID:"13" AND data_win_eventdata_targetObject:/.*TelemetryController.*/ AND data_win_eventdata_targetObject:/.*Command.*/))

cases.input:
name: A New Trust Was Created To A Domain
id: 0255a820-e564-4e40-af2b-6ac61160335c
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2024-01-16"
author: Thomas Patzke
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 0255a820-e564-4e40-af2b-6ac61160335c
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: production
type: TTP

description: >
  Addition of domains is seldom and should be verified for legitimacy. MITRE
  ATT&CK: T1098.

data_source:
  - Windows Security Event Log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "4706"
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_eventdata_subjectUserName
    - data_win_eventdata_subjectLogonId

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires the Windows Security event log collected by the Wazuh agent
  (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf) with the relevant audit policy
  subcategories enabled via GPO. The detection looks for events where
  data_win_system_eventID equals '4706'.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate extension of domain structure. Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/it-pro/windows-10/security/threat-protection/auditing/event-4706
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1098/

response:
  message: >
    A New Trust Was Created To A Domain detected on host $agent_name$. Matched
    data_win_eventdata_subjectUserName: $data_win_eventdata_subjectUserName$.
    Matched data_win_eventdata_subjectLogonId:
    $data_win_eventdata_subjectLogonId$. MITRE ATT&CK: T1098
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_eventdata_subjectUserName
      type: user
    - field: data_win_eventdata_subjectLogonId
      type: other

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1098
  custom_tags:
    - trust
    - domain
    - windows_security
    - privilege_escalation
    - persistence
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_eventID:"4706"

cases.label: rule file detections/sharepoint_onedrive/m365_mass_external_sharing.yaml
cases.input:
name: M365 Mass External Sharing
id: M365_Mass_External_Sharing
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-07-02"
author: SOCFortress LLC
status: production
type: aggregation
description: >
  Detects a user externally sharing multiple SharePoint or OneDrive files within a
  short time window, via anonymous ("anyone with the link") sharing links or by
  granting access to external guest accounts. While occasional external sharing is
  normal, a burst of external shares by one user is a strong data-exfiltration
  signal: a malicious insider or a compromised account exposing corporate documents
  to attacker-controlled anonymous links or external identities. The base query
  isolates external and anonymous shares (ignoring the far more common internal
  group and member shares, and automated meeting-recording shares), then counts
  them per user.
  MITRE ATT&CK: T1213.002 (Data from Information Repositories: SharePoint), T1567 (Exfiltration Over Web Service).
data_source:
  - Office 365 Management Activity API
  - "Workload: SharePoint / OneDrive"
workload: SharePoint
how_to_implement: >
  Requires the Office 365 audit log ingestion pipeline feeding Graylog via the
  O365 Management Activity API, with SharePoint/OneDrive auditing enabled so
  sharing operations (SharingSet, AddedToSecureLink; RecordType 14,
  SharePointSharingOperation) are recorded. This is an aggregation detection: the
  base graylog.query isolates external shares only, matched three ways in
  data_office365_TargetUserOrGroupName / data_office365_TargetUserOrGroupType:
  anonymous links (name contains "Anonymous"), external guest UPNs (name contains
  "#ext#"), and guest targets (type "Guest"). These are standard M365 markers and
  are consistent across tenants and locales. Internal SharePointGroup/SecurityGroup/
  Member shares and automated app@sharepoint meeting-recording shares are naturally
  excluded because their targets are internal. The aggregation then counts external
  shares per user over the window. O365 CreationTime arrives with a malformed
  timezone offset (+0000) and is replaced at ingest, so windowing keys off Graylog's
  own timestamp.
known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate external collaboration (sharing documents with clients, partners, or
  vendors via guest access or link) will trigger this if done in volume. Users who
  routinely work with external parties, and departments that share deliverables
  externally, are common benign causes. Review the shared file names and external
  targets; tune the threshold per tenant and consider allowlisting known partner
  domains if external collaboration is heavy.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1213/002/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1567/
response:
  message: >
    Mass external sharing: $data_office365_UserId$ shared multiple files externally
    (anonymous link or guest access) within the aggregation window from
    $data_office365_ClientIP$ ($data_office365_ClientIP_country_code$). Latest target:
    $data_office365_TargetUserOrGroupName$. Review for data exfiltration.
    MITRE ATT&CK: T1213.002
  risk_score: 70
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: data_office365_UserId
      type: user
      score: 70
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_office365_ClientIP
      type: ip_address
    - field: data_office365_TargetUserOrGroupName
      type: recipient
tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Office 365 Data Exfiltration
    - Insider Threat
  asset_type: Cloud Identity
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1213.002
    - T1567
  custom_tags:
    - o365
    - sharepoint
    - onedrive
    - external_sharing
    - anonymous_link
    - guest_access
    - data_exfiltration
    - aggregation
  product:
    - Office 365
  security_domain: cloud
graylog:
  query: data_office365_Operation:("SharingSet" OR "AddedToSecureLink") AND (data_office365_TargetUserOrGroupName:/.*[aA]nonymous.*/ OR data_office365_TargetUserOrGroupName:/.*#ext#.*/ OR data_office365_TargetUserOrGroupType:"Guest")
aggregation:
  enabled: true
  function: count
  field: null
  group_by:
    - data_office365_UserId
  window: 10m
  threshold: 2
  condition: ">"

cases.input:
name: M365 Mass File Download
id: M365_Mass_File_Download
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-07-02"
author: SOCFortress LLC
status: production
type: aggregation
description: >
  Detects a single user downloading an unusually high volume of files from
  SharePoint or OneDrive within a short time window. High-volume downloads by
  one user are a strong indicator of data exfiltration, whether by a malicious
  insider staging data for removal or an attacker operating a compromised
  account. Fires when a user exceeds the download threshold within the
  aggregation window.
  MITRE ATT&CK: T1213 (Data from Information Repositories), T1567 (Exfiltration Over Web Service).

data_source:
  - Office 365 Management Activity API
  - "Workload: SharePoint / OneDrive"

workload: SharePoint

how_to_implement: >
  Requires the Office 365 audit log ingestion pipeline feeding Graylog via the
  O365 Management Activity API, with SharePoint/OneDrive auditing enabled so
  FileDownloaded operations (RecordType 6) are recorded. This is an aggregation
  detection: the base graylog.query isolates download events, and the
  aggregation block counts them per user over the window. Note: O365 CreationTime
  arrives with a malformed timezone offset (+0000) and is replaced at ingest, so
  windowing keys off Graylog's own timestamp rather than data_office365_CreationTime.
  Confirmed against live AGTNetworks tenant data — FileDownloaded events populate
  data_office365_UserId, data_office365_ClientIP, and data_office365_ObjectId.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate bulk activity can trigger this: users syncing a large SharePoint
  library for the first time, migrations, backups, offboarding data handovers,
  or automated/service accounts that pull many files. Tune the threshold and
  window per tenant, and consider excluding known service accounts by UserId.
  A high sustained baseline for specific power users may warrant per-user tuning.

references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1213/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1567/

response:
  message: >
    Mass file download detected: $data_office365_UserId$ downloaded a high volume
    of files from SharePoint/OneDrive within the aggregation window.
    Source IP: $data_office365_ClientIP$ ($data_office365_ClientIP_country_code$).
    Review for potential data exfiltration. MITRE ATT&CK: T1213, T1567
  risk_score: 75
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: data_office365_UserId
      type: user
      score: 75
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_office365_ClientIP
      type: ip_address
    - field: data_office365_ObjectId
      type: file_name

tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Office 365 Data Exfiltration
    - Insider Threat
  asset_type: Cloud Identity
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1213
    - T1567
  custom_tags:
    - o365
    - sharepoint
    - onedrive
    - file_download
    - data_exfiltration
    - aggregation
  product:
    - Office 365
  security_domain: cloud

graylog:
  query: data_office365_Operation:"FileDownloaded"

aggregation:
  enabled: true
  function: count          
  field: null             
  group_by:
    - data_office365_UserId
  window: 10m
  threshold: 21
  condition: ">"

v.v: Detects a single user downloading an unusually high volume of files from SharePoint or OneDrive within a short time window. High-volume downloads by one user are a strong indicator of data exfiltration, whether by a malicious insider staging data for removal or an attacker operating a compromised account. Fires when a user exceeds the download threshold within the aggregation window. MITRE ATT&CK: T1213 (Data from Information Repositories), T1567 (Exfiltration Over Web Service).

Requires the Office 365 audit log ingestion pipeline feeding Graylog via the O365 Management Activity API, with SharePoint/OneDrive auditing enabled so FileDownloaded operations (RecordType 6) are recorded. This is an aggregation detection: the base graylog.query isolates download events, and the aggregation block counts them per user over the window. Note: O365 CreationTime arrives with a malformed timezone offset (+0000) and is replaced at ingest, so windowing keys off Graylog's own timestamp rather than data_office365_CreationTime. Confirmed against live AGTNetworks tenant data — FileDownloaded events populate data_office365_UserId, data_office365_ClientIP, and data_office365_ObjectId.

cases.label: rule file detections/syslog/cve_2021_4034.yaml
cases.input:
name: Linux pkexec Privilege Escalation
id: linux-pkexec-privilege-escalation-001
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-02-04"
author: SOCFortress LLC
status: production
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects the execution of pkexec on Linux systems. This detection monitors for 
  pkexec usage patterns that could indicate privilege escalation attempts, 
  including the CVE-2021-4034 (PwnKit) vulnerability where pkexec is executed 
  without command-line arguments to gain root privileges.

data_source:
  - auth.log
  - Tetragon
  - audit.log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        - wildcard:
            full_log: "*pkexec*"
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
      must_not:
        - exists:
            field: data_win_system_eventID
        - wildcard:
            rule_groups: "*windows*"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - full_log
    - rule_mitre_id
    - rule_description
    - location

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "Amine"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-02-04 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-02-04 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  This detection requires Wazuh agents deployed on Linux endpoints with auth.log 
  and audit.log monitoring enabled. Tetragon provides additional process execution 
  visibility including parent-child relationships.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate use of pkexec for authorized privilege elevation. The CVE-2021-4034 
  exploit specifically involves pkexec with no arguments, which is highly anomalous. 
  Filter based on known administrative patterns.

references:
  - https://www.reddit.com/r/crowdstrike/comments/sdfeig/20220126_cool_query_friday_hunting_pwnkit_local/
  - https://linux.die.net/man/1/pkexec
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/linux-system-service-bug-gives-root-on-all-major-distros-exploit-released/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/

response:
  message: >
    pkexec execution detected on $agent_name$. 
    Monitor for CVE-2021-4034 (PwnKit) exploitation where pkexec runs with no arguments. 
    MITRE ATT&CK: $rule_mitre_id$
  risk_score: 56
  severity: high
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 56
  threat_objects: []

tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Linux Privilege Escalation
    - Linux Living Off The Land
  asset_type: CVE
  cve:
    - CVE-2021-4034
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1068
    - T1078
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

cases.input:
name: Linux User Account Creation Detection
id: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-01-29"
author: SOCFORTRESS LLC
status: production
type: TTP
description: >
  Detects attempts to create new user accounts on Linux systems using useradd 
  or adduser commands. This activity may indicate legitimate system administration 
  or could represent an attacker establishing persistence by creating rogue accounts.
  
data_source:
  - Wazuh Agent Logs
  - Linux Auditd
  - Syslog
search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  full_log: "*useradd*"
              - wildcard:
                  full_log: "*adduser*"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
      
      must_not:
        - exists:
            field: data_win_system_eventID
        - wildcard:
            rule_groups: "*windows*"
  
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_process_exec_process_binary
    - data_process_exec_process_arguments
    - rule_mitre_id
    - rule_description
    - full_log
parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "Amine"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-01-28 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-01-28 23:59:59.999"
how_to_implement: >
  This detection requires Wazuh agents deployed on Linux endpoints with 
  process execution logging enabled. Ensure the agent is configured to 
  capture command-line arguments. The index pattern should match your 
  Wazuh index naming convention.
known_false_positives: >
  System administrators legitimately creating user accounts for new employees 
  or service accounts. Automated provisioning systems may also trigger this 
  detection. Consider creating allowlists for known admin users or automation 
  service accounts.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1136/001/
  - https://documentation.wazuh.com/current/user-manual/capabilities/index.html
response:
  message: >
    User account creation detected on $agent_name$. 
    Command: $data_process_exec_process_binary$ $data_process_exec_process_arguments$
    MITRE ATT&CK: $rule_mitre_id$
  risk_score: 45
  severity: medium
  
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 45
  
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_process_exec_process_binary
      type: process
tags:
  analytic_story:
    - Linux Persistence Techniques
    - Account Manipulation
  asset_type: Linux
  mitre_attack_id:
    - T1136.001  
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

  query: (full_log:/.*useradd.*/ OR full_log:/.*adduser.*/) AND NOT _exists_:data_win_system_eventID AND NOT rule_groups:/.*windows.*/

cases.label: rule file detections/system_eventlog/anydesk_remote_access_software_service_installation.yaml
cases.input:
name: Anydesk Remote Access Software Service Installation
id: 530a6faa-ff3d-4022-b315-50828e77eef5
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2025-02-24"
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 530a6faa-ff3d-4022-b315-50828e77eef5
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects the installation of the anydesk software service. Which could be an
  indication of anydesk abuse if you the software isn't already used.

data_source:
  - Windows System Event Log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - term:
            data_win_system_providerName:
              value: "Service Control Manager"
              case_insensitive: true
        - term:
            data_win_system_eventID: "7045"
        - bool:
            should:
              - bool:
                  must:
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_serviceName:
                          value: "*AnyDesk*"
                          case_insensitive: true
                    - wildcard:
                        data_win_eventdata_serviceName:
                          value: "*Service*"
                          case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_imagePath:
                    value: "*AnyDesk*"
                    case_insensitive: true
            minimum_should_match: 1
        # ---- end generated ----
        - range:
            timestamp:
              gte: "${START_TIME}"
              lte: "${END_TIME}"
  _source:
    - timestamp
    - agent_name
    - data_win_system_eventID
    - data_win_system_providerName
    - data_win_eventdata_serviceName
    - data_win_eventdata_imagePath

parameters:
  AGENT_NAME:
    description: "Target agent/host name"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "DESKTOP-AM0HLGE"
  CUSTOMER_CODE:
    description: "Customer label for filtering"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "lab"
  INDEX_PATTERN:
    description: "Elasticsearch index pattern"
    type: string
    required: true
    example: "wazuh-lab_*"
  START_TIME:
    description: "Query start time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now-24h"
    example: "2026-04-08 00:00:00.000"
  END_TIME:
    description: "Query end time (ISO 8601 or relative)"
    type: datetime
    required: false
    default: "now"
    example: "2026-04-08 23:59:59.999"

how_to_implement: >
  Requires the relevant built-in Windows event channel collected by the Wazuh
  agent (eventchannel localfile entry in ossec.conf). The detection looks for
  events where data_win_system_providerName equals 'Service Control Manager';
  data_win_system_eventID equals '7045'; data_win_eventdata_serviceName matches
  '*AnyDesk*', among other conditions.

known_false_positives: >
  Legitimate usage of the anydesk tool. Baseline expected activity in your
  environment and tune this detection before relying on it for automated
  response.

references:
  - https://thedfirreport.com/2022/08/08/bumblebee-roasts-its-way-to-domain-admin/
  - https://thedfirreport.com/2025/02/24/confluence-exploit-leads-to-lockbit-ransomware/

response:
  message: >
    Anydesk Remote Access Software Service Installation detected on host
    $agent_name$. Matched data_win_system_providerName:
    $data_win_system_providerName$. Matched data_win_eventdata_serviceName:
    $data_win_eventdata_serviceName$.
  risk_score: 50
  severity: medium
  risk_objects:
    - field: agent_name
      type: system
      score: 50
  threat_objects:
    - field: data_win_system_providerName
      type: other
    - field: data_win_eventdata_serviceName
      type: service

tags:
  asset_type: Endpoint
  custom_tags:
    - anydesk
    - software
    - service
    - windows_system
    - persistence
  product:
    - Wazuh
  security_domain: endpoint

graylog:
  query: data_win_system_providerName:/[Ss][Ee][Rr][Vv][Ii][Cc][Ee] [Cc][Oo][Nn][Tt][Rr][Oo][Ll] [Mm][Aa][Nn][Aa][Gg][Ee][Rr]/ AND data_win_system_eventID:"7045" AND ((data_win_eventdata_serviceName:/.*[Aa][Nn][Yy][Dd][Ee][Ss][Kk].*/ AND data_win_eventdata_serviceName:/.*[Ss][Ee][Rr][Vv][Ii][Cc][Ee].*/) OR data_win_eventdata_imagePath:/.*[Aa][Nn][Yy][Dd][Ee][Ss][Kk].*/)

cases.input:
name: Important Scheduled Task Deleted or Disabled
id: 9e3cb244-bdb8-4632-8c90-6079c8f4f16d
version: 1
schema_version: "1.0"
date: "2026-03-11"
author: frack113
source:
  format: sigma
  repository: SigmaHQ/sigma
  rule_id: 9e3cb244-bdb8-4632-8c90-6079c8f4f16d
  commit: release-20260810
  license: DRL-1.1
converted_by: Moussa Amine — sigma2copilot v0.1.0
status: experimental
type: TTP

description: >
  Detects when adversaries try to stop system services or processes by deleting
  or disabling their respective scheduled tasks in order to conduct data
  destructive activities. MITRE ATT&CK: T1489.

data_source:
  - Windows Task Scheduler Operational Event Log

search:
  index_pattern: "${INDEX_PATTERN}"
  size: 100
  sort:
    - timestamp: desc
  query:
    bool:
      must:
        - term:
            agent_name: "${AGENT_NAME}"
        - term:
            agent_labels_customer: "${CUSTOMER_CODE}"
        
        - bool:
            should:
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "141"
              - term:
                  data_win_system_eventID: "142"
            minimum_should_match: 1
        - bool:
            should:
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_taskName:
                    value: "*\\\\Windows\\\\SystemRestore\\\\SR*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_taskName:
                    value: "*\\\\Windows\\\\Windows Defender\\\\*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_taskName:
                    value: "*\\\\Windows\\\\BitLocker*"
                    case_insensitive: true
              - wildcard:
                  data_win_eventdata_taskName:
                    value: "*\\\\Windows\\\\WindowsBackup\\\\*"
                    case_insensitive: true
